newsitem.title: POLAND: WBK TO UP CREDIT, DEPOSIT RATES.
newsitem.headline: WBK TO UP CREDIT, DEPOSIT RATES.

text.p: Poland's WielkopolskI Bank Kredytowy SA (WBK) will raise its credit rates by an average of two percentage points as of August 11, it said in a statement.
WBK also said it would raise its deposit rates by between 0.5 and three points from the same date.
It said its fixed rate 12-month credit rate will rise to 27.5 percent and its 12-month deposit to 19.5 percent.
On Monday the central bank increased its lombard rate by two points to 27 percent and its discount rate by 2.5 points to 24.5 percent. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
